南湾：Santa Clara County HHW 要预约并核对居住证明；Pal: South Bay: Santa Clara County HHW requires appointments and residency checks. Palo Alto residents use the city program.
东湾：Alameda County 居民从 StopWaste 查设施；常设点无: East Bay: Alameda County residents can find facilities through StopWaste. Permanent facilities do not require appointments, but check opening dates and accepted items. Other counties have their own programs.
北湾：Marin 从 Marin HHW 查起，Novato 另查本地设施；不能: North Bay: start with Marin HHW, while Novato has its own facility. Marin eligibility does not extend to Sonoma or Napa.

Resident programs generally cover waste from your own household; business, contractor and collected waste need separate checks. Some drop-off addresses arrive only after booking, so use your confirmation for directions. Do not rely on an old map or assume one disposal fee covers every item.
